measurement.method: Manual landmark sampling; parallel-edge rectification; metric scale anchored to project floor pitch, not real-world photogrammetry.
measurement.scale_formula: normalized vertical_px_per_m = 298/5.1 = 58.43; floor pitch comes from the project specification. Adopted width/depth 8.6/8.2 m are perspective-informed proportion estimates, not direct px/58.43 horizontal conversion.
limitations: Reference is a single stylized image; concealed depth/roof back slope are inferred.
Project standard equal storey pitch overrides uneven apparent facade bands.
Reference people omitted: requested buildings/facilities/plants only.
Illustrated advertisement reconstructed as palette-coloured geometry, no extra image texture.
measurement.coordinate_space: Reference resized to 1080x1080 for every landmark; multiply normalized pixel coordinates by 1200/1080 for original image coordinates.
measurement.uncertainty_note: Point-selection tolerance only. Perspective, stylization and occlusion introduce additional unknown metric uncertainty; inferred dimensions are adopted modelling dimensions, not physically calibrated survey measurements.
